scenario: [LNLS.3.3]: the positive control for LNLS.3.3c_negated_unanchored. The negated pattern pins `R`'s full key (`x.id == d.id`), and a range comparison on top is allowed as it is for a positive pattern. Each new `D` token probes at most one `R`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors` judging a `no` pattern through `full_key_anchor`.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema D scope logical:
    id: String key
    level: Int mutable

schema R scope logical:
    id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

rule r:
    D d
    no R x where x.id == d.id and x.amount > d.level
->
    log info "x"
